method: (1) ecbench verify --replay-all on each of the three sessions, using a copy of the binary whose SHA-256 equals every session's and every record's binary_sha256. Every measured deterministic run was re-executed and its counts compared with the record; warm-up runs are not replay candidates. (2) For every record, warm-ups included, the validator's own Rust affine arithmetic (std only, u128 products, no code shared with ecbench) checks [d]G = Q for the recovered d and rejects [d+1]G = Q as a negative control. It works on y^2 = x^3 + b over F_p, with p, t, r parsed from the record's ICV1 string and b derived from G and required to be 7, and it checks p and r prime, r = p + 1 - t and rG = O. (3) An independent rebuild of ecbench from the committed source, also replayed on j0b7-34 (binary_provenance).
commands: for s in 34 37 40; do jq -r --arg sess j0b7-$s -f $SP/tools/extract.jq sessions/j0b7-$s/records.jsonl; done > $SP/work/records.tsv; $SP/tools/check < $SP/work/records.tsv > $SP/work/check.out
host_caveat: Replayed on the same 4-vCPU VM class that produced the sessions (auditor env class ECBENV3h019d40ac615e, hardware ECBHW1he9e33daae9e7). This is an independent process and invocation, not another host class. AGENTS.md 12 asks for another host class only for an ecbench vs_rho claim, which this result does not make.

Of the 6,633 differing bytes, 6,613 are in .strtab and 20 in .note.gnu.build-id; 0 are in .text, .rodata, .data, .data.rel.ro, .eh_frame, .gcc_except_table, .rela.* or any other loaded section. The 778 differing strings are crypto_lib symbol names that differ only in the ThinLTO .llvm.<hash> promotion suffix; with that suffix removed the string sets are identical.
binary_provenance.summary: The session binary's executable image is byte-identical to a fresh build of the committed source, and the rebuilt binary replays j0b7-34 1,260/1,260 identical. The two files differ only in non-loaded symbol-name hashes and the build-id. The session binary (mtime 02:47:22Z) was built from the working tree before 4e2ea6c1be was committed (03:11:01Z). The cause of the symbol-hash difference (an uncommitted source state not reachable from ecbench, or build-environment nondeterminism) was not established. This is a provenance note (errata N5), not a validity defect.
